text:
hana: Postmortem follow-up: we need an action tracker for rollout safety items. Short list: infra hard-caps, auto-rollback rules, simulation jobs, and recurring-pattern detection.
pete: I can take infra hard-caps. Plan: enforce router-level hard_cap and emit audit events. Will add 429 when client tries to exceed.
eli: I'll draft auto-rollback signal combinatorics. Suggest requiring two signals (error-rate spike + p95 regress) and a 90s debounce to avoid flapping.
grace: I'll own the sim harness and the staging dry-run. Plan: deterministic sims that output CSV and a short summary that maps to rollback triggers.
sentry-bot: system: Incident 2026-04-11 created follow-up ticket: INC-9342. Linked to this thread.
hana: Good. Owners + deadlines: pete (router hard-cap + audit) PR by Tue 04/14, eli (rollback rule RFC + tests) PR by Thu 04/16, grace (sim harness + CI job) PR by Mon 04/20.
pete: Implementation note: router config example:
```
rollout:
  hard_cap_percent: 1
  hard_enforce: true
  audit_header: X-Rollout-Audit
```
eli: Proposed auto-rollback pseudo-rule:
```
if error_rate_60s > baseline*1.5 and p95_60s > baseline_p95*1.25 for 90s:
  trigger("auto_rollback", reason="safety_thresholds")
```
grace: Sim permutations: sample_rate [0.1%,0.5%,1%], error_inject [0,0.5%,1%], latency_shift [+20ms,+200ms]. Each run writes results/rollout-<id>.csv
hana: Also add a nightly scanner to detect correlated small rollouts that together cause escalations. That was a root cause.
pete: Will add aggregation tags to audit events: rollout.id, flag.name, region, owner so scanner can group.
eli: We should require a fallback route (stable) in the routing layer and ensure rollback is atomic and paged. Add a test that verifies traffic returns to stable if rollback triggered.
grace: CI test plan: run a short sim that triggers rollback rules, assert alert fired, assert traffic switched, and snapshot metrics. Deterministic seed included.
sentry-bot: system: Task created TASK-9902: add router hard-cap assigned to pete.
hana: Ops playbook updates: 1) How to triage auto-rollbacks 2) Who to page 3) Re-open criteria 4) How to snapshot outputs for postmortem. Assign to aj and ops-docs.
pete: Console note: add a visible "hard cap" indicator and an override button that requires 2 approvers and writes audit reason. We'll implement UI later.
eli: One more: exponential backoff for reopen attempts (1m, 5m, 15m) to avoid repeated harmful widenings.
grace: Scheduling staging dry-run Thu 04/23 10:00 PDT. Will post invite.
hana: Great. Ping this thread with PR links. We'll review in next eng-platform meeting. :white_check_mark:
